assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: No chronology of her states is established. The support communications and Dear appearances are school-year scenes with the Producer as her Producer Course student, with one located state marker (Kanae's school episode, with China already Prima Stella). Event 029 is a separately bounded April 1 continuity in which she is produced as an idol, and the 2025 and 2026 seasonal dream scenes are separately bounded; neither establishes biography, a past career or a lasting change of relation. Whatever preceded her teaching is withheld by her and outside scope.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution) and the owner's A/B boundary direction of 24 November 2026 in PR #694, not yet recorded in the policy: A turns on the integration, individuation and transferability of the model within a declared scope; interpretations that predict the same behavior may coexist; divergent transfer conditions, missing evidence and unsettled dispositions are named and excluded rather than counted against the tier; held-out validation, analytical derivation, relationship labels and preserved source chronology are not barriers. Evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The portrait's organizing account: she wants a promising student to keep looking after an idol while learning to be a person among working people; she likes being the teacher he comes to and holds that relying only on her is an inadequate social education; she turns a difficulty between two people into a trial to discuss afterward; she invites curiosity about herself while controlling disclosure; and she is sensitive to the reversal in which she becomes the one evaluated (adv_csprt-2-0014_01, _02; adv_csprt-3-0019_03). It rules out the indifference and the special-access readings. Not B: the account does not settle what decides her response at its branch points. The portrait lets a private correction produce 'recognition, resistance or a self-correction', and in Kanae's episode it refuses to say that the three options carry the same private assessment, so caution and respect for enthusiasm are left without a deciding rule. Not D: the account is organized and makes narrow, located predictions within the student relationship.

No development or ordered sequence of her states is traced. The Event 029 motivation cannot fill in her career history, the seasonal dream scenes illuminate a motif without establishing biography, and the final address わたしの――プロデューサーくん need not be a permanent relation (adv_event_029_main-04; adv_startup_2025, _2026). Not D: the only state marker is Kanae's episode with China already Prima Stella, and no change of her own is located.

Located forms: self-reference that toggles between 先生 and わたし, polite sentence endings with the student-facing きみ and name plus くん, office formality, an ungainly interruption and private interest within one conversation, and the final Event 029 address わたしの――プロデューサーくん alongside continued 先生. Not B: the rules are few, sampled almost only with the Producer, and the portrait names the performed voice of the friendship offer, the magician lesson and the last address as open P1 questions. Not D: the forms are specific and located by script.

A few ordinary scenes inside lessons: lunch with the student on a this-time-only condition, a convenience-store box lunch explained by a missed breakfast, an offer to exchange handmade lunches to show that she can cook, and curiosity about which teacher the producers find cutest (adv_csprt-3-0019_02, -0020_01 to _03). Not C: the portrait itself finds no reliable claim about her appetite, and her home routine and life outside school are absent. Not E: the scenes are located and show ordinary relations rather than a generic guide role.

Almost all evidence is one directed relation, with the Producer as her student, varied by role: instructor, offered friend, evaluated party and, in Event 029, an idol he produces (adv_csprt-2-0014_01; adv_csprt-3-0019_03; adv_event_029_main-01 to -04). Saki, Temari, Kotone and an unnamed colleague respond to her in Event 029, but their responses are theirs and do not show how she conditions on them. Not C: no second directed tie is modeled, so the record cannot say how her conduct differs by person. Not E: within the one relation, role-dependent variation is located.

Direct interior access is two located inner lines: the reservation about a premature double commitment in one planning alternative of Kanae's episode, and the sense of no escape in Event 029, written with its own voice cue and kept apart from her outward objection (adv_pevent_001_hkne_school_010; adv_event_029_main-01). Otherwise motives are read from dialogue and her stated enjoyment. Not C: no sustained access. Not E: the inner lines are direct and differ from what she says.

One conflict scene: in Event 029 she doubts that being produced by a student is good for him, challenges the public announcement made without consulting her, and, once she agrees, says half-hearted effort would slight the idol students (adv_event_029_main-01, -02). Elsewhere she refuses to tell what she dreamed, especially to him (adv_startup_2026). Not C: no other opposition is shown, and Event 029 is a separately bounded continuity. Not E: the objections and the turn to full effort are located.

Stated professional principles: a genuine stake must be said aloud so that it can enter a decision (adv_dear_amao_024), half-hearted effort makes light of those who work at it (Event 029), and dependability before an idol may begin as a performance (the magician lesson). The portrait tests that lesson against the Producer's own choices in Hiro Dear 010 and Rinami Dear 022, and assigns those choices to him. Her one shown weighing, caution against respect for enthusiasm in Kanae's episode, is option-dependent. Not C: no weighing of hers is resolved. Not E: several principles are located with their contexts.

Located play with a function: insisting that she is very young rather than merely looks it (adv_csprt-2-0014_02), the improvised ten points and the promised Asari-sensei points inside a rehearsal she designed (adv_csprt-3-0019_03), curiosity about the cutest-teacher talk, and worry about her box lunch. The portrait reads this as joking vulnerability that constrains a generic tutorial-guide reading. Not B: a handful of scenes with one interlocutor, and delivery is unheard. Not D: style and function are characterized across scenes.

One dedicated, independently reviewed, text-grounded portrait locates each claim by script and line range over about fifteen scenes. Not B: it is built from named scenes rather than an enumeration of her appearances, four recorded-performance P1s and any sung or whole-show observation remain open, and the side-character synthesis is not on the row. Not D: the claims are specific and traceable to script lines.

Affirmative bounds are located against specific overreadings: nothing shows that Asari authorized the Producer's choices in Hiro Dear 010 or Rinami Dear 022; the Asari-sensei points are not an institutional grading system and her first answer is not an enrollment; the friendship offer does not change her responsibility as an instructor; she gives no settled account of her past, so age, previous agency or an idol debut cannot be reconstructed; the instrumental score cue does not establish sung performance; matching printed language across dream scenes carries no recorded delivery or employment; the three Kanae options are not one private assessment; and the tower scene describes an assignment that must still be won, not a job awarded. Not A: the bounds are few and none is a disconfirmed forecast. Not C: each is located by script.

The portrait keeps Event 029 and the seasonal scenes apart from the school-year scenes and gives one state marker (China already Prima Stella in Kanae's episode), but the scenes are not ordered relative to one another. Not C: no chronology of her states. Not E: continuities and the one marker are kept distinct.

conditions: Output is illustrative written Japanese, never quotation; no performed voice is claimed, and the four recorded-performance P1s and any singing remain open.

Self-reference toggling between 先生 and わたし; polite sentence endings; the student addressed as きみ or by name plus くん; office formality that can give way to an ungainly interruption or personal curiosity.

Interlocutor is a Producer Course student she teaches, as sampled; other students, colleagues, family or strangers are unsampled and any transfer is a separate, lower-confidence condition limited to these register rules.
Questions about her past draw deflection into an assignment, not disclosure; the Event 029 address わたしの――プロデューサーくん belongs to that event only.
scenario_readiness.note: The text-grounded register is specific enough for bounded illustrative output with her student, not for performed or sung voice.

conditions: A promising student isolating himself in work: predict sincere praise, a question about whom he sees away from work, a case for horizontal relationships with older and working classmates, and possibly a personal interest in his answer; she sets the size of any favor herself.

Someone praises a capacity she takes for granted, inside an exercise she designed: predict a request for a better pitch, a reaction as though it mattered and an improvised return to teacher vocabulary; whether a private correction then draws recognition, resistance or self-correction is not predicted.
A student asks who she is or what she did before: predict that the serious question is recognized and turned into a research assignment, with no settled disclosure.

Advising a change in an idol's work: predict that the producer's own desire and the idol's willingness are treated as part of the situation and that a stake is asked to be said aloud; whether she voices or withholds a reservation is not predicted.
A student seeking a next step for his idol: predict that an existing institutional route with a real assignment to be won is introduced, not a job handed over.
Include her overreach: enjoyment of being the teacher sought out, embarrassment at visible lapses, and being caught off guard by a reversal she set up.
Exclude her biography, age, previous career or idol debut, family, home life, romance, her performed or sung voice, and any generalization of the Event 029 role reversal into a lasting relation.
